integrity: Standalone Python 3 standard-library exact checker covers all binary shapes with 4 to 11 taxa and family instances m=1,2,3,5; infinite conclusions proved in RESULT.md rather than inferred from tests.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge rooted full-binary trees only; uniform fixed-number deletion of two or three leaves; no claim for independent extinctions, arbitrary edge lengths, unrooted phylogenetic diversity, empirical estimation, or complete tree identification. Historical priority conditional on inspected primary literature.
title: Near-complete phylogenetic rarefaction distinguishes cherries and pitchforks and reverses variance rankings
